name: The St. Regis Red Sea Resort
insider_take: This ultra-luxury resort sits on a pristine private island in the Red Sea, where untouched coral reefs meet world-class hospitality in one of Saudi Arabia's most exclusive destinations.
whats_special: The St. Regis Red Sea Resort occupies an entire private island within the ambitious Red Sea Project, Saudi Arabia's flagship tourism development. The resort features overwater villas - a first for the region - and sits atop some of the world's most pristine coral reefs. The island is part of a vast archipelago that remained untouched for decades, creating an ecosystem so pure that 75% of the marine life here is found nowhere else on Earth.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the overwater spa pavilions during sunset - the play of light across the Red Sea's crystal-clear waters creates an almost ethereal experience that's become legendary among luxury travelers.
dont_miss: The resort's house reef is accessible directly from the beach, offering some of the Red Sea's best snorkeling without a boat trip. The island's position creates unique wind patterns that make it ideal for water sports year-round, while the nearby Sheybarah Island houses ancient archaeological sites dating back thousands of years, accessible via the resort's private yacht transfers.
pros: Exclusive private island location offering unparalleled privacy and pristine natural beauty
World-class diving and snorkeling with direct access to vibrant coral reefs
Legendary St. Regis butler service providing personalized luxury hospitality
Sustainable luxury resort design harmoniously integrated with the marine ecosystem
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane or boat transfer
Ultra-luxury pricing reflecting exclusive positioning and limited accessibility
